sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.
the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The only approval for Chisone on BR-180 is for Beinasco (PLT-BEI). The ASL has no entry for Pinerolo (PLT-PIN). The approval is per part, receiving plant and customer. The 2026-11-06 return to approved status is a company-level audit result and does not add a part approval for Pinerolo.

sources.quote: Approval is granted per part number and per manufacturing site.

The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BR-180 belongs to PRG-Z, which is an Aurelia program. Aurelia's manual revision 4 replaces revision 3 and is in force. Under it, the move to Pinerolo is a change of source. It needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipment, plus 90 days' notice. Nothing in force covers this. DEV-114 for BR-180 has expired and concerned hardness.
